label: Whatever has power for the actual contingents' joint absence exists at w
paraphrase: OPEN (analyst formulation, unattributed): whatever has at w a power (PowerFor) for the joint absence of the concrete beings contingent at w exists at w. The actualist reading of powers (a power held at a world is held by a being of that world), restricted to this one power. Without it a holder can exist only at a non-actual world (controls).
